home.audio: Welcome! Spin the wheel of fortune or choose a gift box to win your special donation. Once you win, a form will open automatically. Enter your name and phone number to receive your gift code and contact the administrator on WhatsApp.
home.intro1: Project Solidaridad is Almira Aldahab Foundation's community initiative, led by its CEO, Amira. It brings together mutual support, participation, and entertainment to offer a clear, accessible, and transparent donation experience, supported by partners such as Pépé Milionario, Keanu Reeves, and Elon Musk.
home.intro2: Our goal is to make solidarity more accessible to everyone. Through a community game and a guided participation process, each participant can understand the steps, generate a unique code, and follow the donation validation process.
home.intro3: Project Solidaridad is more than a game: it is a community built around sharing, generosity, and trust. Every participation supports Almira Aldahab Foundation's vision of creating a useful, clear, and accessible initiative.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: This policy explains what information is used for Project Solidaridad and how it is protected.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The information on this site relates to Project Solidaridad, a community initiative by Almira Aldahab Foundation, led by Amira. For questions about your personal data, contact the team from the contact page.

sections.title: 2. Information we use
paragraphs: When you take part in the game, the site may use the information you enter in the form: surname, first name, country, and WhatsApp number. The system also generates a unique code linked to your participation.
Please provide only the information needed to process your participation. The form does not ask for a password or banking details.

sections.title: 3. How the community game works
paragraphs: Project Solidaridad is a community game offered by Almira Aldahab Foundation. To take part, you enter the requested information and the site generates a unique code used to identify and track your request during validation.
Participation is personal and must follow the instructions on the site. Generating a code does not by itself confirm a donation or reward: the team must verify it, and the game's terms apply.

sections.title: 4. How information is used
bullets: Record and track your participation in Project Solidaridad.
Generate and link your unique code to your participation.
Contact you about validation, a donation, or a reward.
At your request, send the information needed to the team via WhatsApp.
Improve the site's clarity, security, and operation.

sections.title: 5. Redirecting to WhatsApp
paragraphs: After your code is generated, you can open WhatsApp to send your information to the team. This third-party service has its own privacy policy and terms of use. Review the message before sending it, and do not share unnecessary information.

sections.title: 6. Retention and security
paragraphs: Information is kept for as long as needed to track your participation, validate your code, and handle your request. Almira Aldahab Foundation uses reasonable measures to limit access and prevent unauthorized use.
No system connected to the Internet can guarantee absolute security. Avoid sending sensitive information that the site does not request.

sections.title: 7. Sharing information
paragraphs: Your data is not sold. It may be shared only with people or services needed to manage your participation, such as when you choose to send a WhatsApp message, or when required by law.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may request access to, correction or deletion of your personal data, or restriction of its use. You may also object to certain processing. To exercise your rights, contact the team from the contact page and include details that help locate your participation.

sections.title: 9. Policy updates
paragraphs: This policy may be updated to reflect changes to the site, its features, or applicable requirements. The version published on this page is the current version.
